name: Record the 3.7.3 applicant-collector fixes in the companion docs
request: Record the 3.7.3 applicant-collector fixes in the companion docs
checks: npm run check passed: typecheck, build 3.7.3, 380 tests, validate
result: Version and build id bumped to 3.7.3 in all five places plus manifest.json and package.json. CHANGELOG.md gained a 3.7.3 entry covering all three live defects and their causes: one scroll policy used for two opposite surfaces so the page won and the applicant column never moved, a page-condition flag latched by visibilitychange and cleared only mid-extraction so a stopped run could not be started without a reload, and a run loop that walked from index 0 and asked nothing about the store. CHECKS.md gained a 3.7.3 section with the four commands actually run, the seven new tests and what each asserts, the plain statement that the 3.7.2 suite passed 373 tests while all three defects were happening, and six things only a live run can confirm - including that the detail column's computed overflow really is auto/scroll and that the applicationId in a row's href is the same id the stored record carries. CLAUDE.md gained a 'Collecting every applicant' section documenting the column scroll policy, livePanel, the shared expansion budget, the collected index and beginRun; rule 9g notes that an already-saved row is walked past without a click; PV_APPLICANT_COLLECTED added to the message list. MEMORY.md gained four durable entries (a column is not the page, a held DOM reference is not the live panel, a latched flag is not a state, a run must know what it already has), PROJECT_STATUS.md leads with the three defects, TECH_STACK.md gained four constraints, and README.md documents that a stopped run resumes and that both columns are scrolled.
